verdicts.reason: The Greek Ministry of Digital Governance is the controller of gov.gr authentication, and GRNET (EDYTE S.A., a Greek state-owned company) designs, implements and maintains the Gov.gr Wallet on its behalf.

The only evidence is a planned consolidation of the Greek Ministry of Migration and Asylum's infrastructure into a Tier-4 data centre, which does not name the Register of Aliens and does not establish who hosts or operates it today.
Law 4389/2016 and the digital strategy both state that TAXIS, TAXISnet and ELENXIS run on Greek state infrastructure (Ministry of Finance GSIS / GGPSDD), operated for the Greek AADE.
ICISnet is named explicitly as hosted on the infrastructure of the Greek General Secretariat for Information Systems of Public Administration (GGPSDD).
The Hellenic Cadastre, a Greek public-law entity, runs its own Data Center and Disaster Recovery Center.
Law 4249/2014 makes the Hellenic Police IT Directorate responsible for designing the police information systems and for creating and supporting their technical infrastructure.
Law 4727/2020 requires all central Greek Ministry of Health information systems to be installed in the state Health Sector Government Cloud (H-Cloud), and no non-EU host appears in the evidence.
